title: SOH CAH TOA
subject: Math
learningGoal: Use sine, cosine, tangent ratios in a right triangle.
spokenLines: SOH CAH TOA — the trig ratios.
SOH: sine equals opposite over hypotenuse.
CAH: cosine equals adjacent over hypotenuse.
TOA: tangent equals opposite over adjacent.
In a right triangle, opposite and adjacent are relative to the angle you pick.
Say opposite is three, adjacent is four, hypotenuse is five, and we want sine of theta.
Sine theta equals three over five, which is zero point six.
Cosine theta is four over five, zero point eight.
Tangent theta is three over four, zero point seven five.
